{
  "categories": [
    {
      "name": "build",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Removes Boost.Test build dependencies, options, and workarounds across CMake, depends, vcpkg, and Guix build scripts.",
      "band": "P3",
      "score": 0.4,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Removes an external library dependency and its platform-specific workarounds from Guix, depends, and CMake. Eliminating Boost.Test simplifies the build configuration and reduces packaging maintenance overhead."
    },
    {
      "name": "ipc",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Changes to ipc test files are mechanical header and macro replacements following from the test framework replacement.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Does not touch IPC logic or interfaces."
    },
    {
      "name": "kernel",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Changes in src/test/kernel/ are purely mechanical test include and macro adjustments.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Does not touch the kernel API or its boundary."
    },
    {
      "name": "tests",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Replaces the external Boost.Test runner with an in-tree unit test framework and assertion system in src/test/util/framework.{h,cpp}.",
      "band": "P2",
      "score": 0.7,
      "reason_tag": "new feature",
      "rationale": "Replaces the external unit test framework with an in-tree framework featuring expression decomposition on failure. This addresses long-standing goals (issue #8670, RFC #34666) to remove Boost.Test reliance and unblock future unit test runner enhancements such as concurrency."
    },
    {
      "name": "tools",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Only touched contrib/guix/libexec/build_linux.sh, which is build machinery rather than a developer tool.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Does not touch developer scripts or CLI tools."
    },
    {
      "name": "wallet",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Wallet changes are mechanical header and test assertion edits driven by the scripted-diff.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Does not change wallet behavior, database, or logic."
    }
  ],
  "factors": {
    "security_stability": 0,
    "bug_severity": 0,
    "performance": 0,
    "user_value": 0,
    "leverage": 2
  }
}
